duration.$description: Lumen v0.13 motion durations. Five-stop ladder aligned to the /foundations page: 80ms micro · 140ms fast · 200ms base · 320ms slow · 480ms slower. The v0.13 retune snaps every duration to the 20ms grid (vs the v0.12.6 0/120/180/260/400 set) so the curve from micro→slower is perceptually even and matches the master refactor briefing. `instant: 0ms` is preserved for hard-cut state changes that must NOT animate.

instant.$description: Hard cut. No transition. Used when prefers-reduced-motion is granted.

micro.$description: v0.13 NEW — sub-perceptual feedback. Press, focus, ripple cap.

fast.$description: v0.13 retune from 120ms — hover, micro-feedback, tap response.

base.$description: v0.13 retune from 180ms — default UI feedback, expand/collapse.

slow.$description: v0.13 retune from 260ms — panel open, drawer slide, sheet entry.

slower.$description: v0.13 retune from 400ms — page-level transitions, hero entry.

easing.$description: v0.13 — six easing tokens. The Lumen `decelerate` (0.2, 0, 0, 1) is the system default for 95% of moments — entry, micro-feedback, hover. Material `standard` (0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) is exposed for parity with Material consumers but is NOT the Lumen default. Bounce is reserved for celebration moments (success affirmation, confetti) and gates on prefers-reduced-motion.

linear.$description: v0.13 NEW — uniform velocity. Marquee, RateTicker, infinite scroll.

decelerate.$description: v0.13 — Lumen default. Entry, micro-feedback, hover, focus. Decelerate-not-bounce per ADR 0016. ALSO published as `standard` for v0.12.x backwards compatibility.

standard.$description: Backwards-compat alias of `decelerate` — the Lumen v0.12.x default. Preserved verbatim across v0.12 → v0.13.

accelerate.$description: Exit side. Thing leaving. Modal dismiss, popover close, page exit.

emphasized.$description: v0.13 — slight overshoot on entry of large state changes. Reserved.

emphasised.$description: British-spelling alias of `emphasized` — preserved from v0.12.6 for backwards compatibility.

bounce.$description: v0.13 NEW — celebration easing. Success affirmation, confetti reveal. NEVER for hover or focus. Honours prefers-reduced-motion → decelerate.

material-standard.$description: v0.13 — Material 3 `standard` curve. Exposed for parity with Material consumers (Compose, Material Web). NOT the Lumen default — reach for `decelerate` first.

spring.$description: v0.13 NEW — physical spring tokens for interactive elements (toggle thumbs, swipe rows, drag releases, sheet rubber-band). SwiftUI / Compose / React-Spring consumers read these; CSS consumers fall back to `decelerate` cubic-bezier. Both springs target 60fps glass-feel — short settle, no over-bounce.

default.$description: Lumen v0.13 default spring. Stiffness 280 / damping 28 / mass 1. Critical-damped feel — arrives, doesn't bounce. Use for thumb / handle / swipe-row release.

gentle.$description: Lumen v0.13 gentle spring. Stiffness 200 / damping 32 / mass 1. Overdamped — slower settle, no overshoot. Use for sheet drag / pull-to-refresh release / drawer snap.

atmosphere.$description: v0.13 NEW — atmospheric motion presets for expressive surfaces. LiveDot pulse (3s loop), RateTicker marquee (linear, infinite, pausable on hover), aurora fade-in (expressive-mode-only). Restrained mode opts out via `prefers-reduced-motion` and via the explicit `data-mode='restrained'` scope dropping `mesh`/`aurora`/`grain` recipes.

live-dot-pulse.$description: LiveDot signature pulse — 3 second loop, ease-in-out, infinite. The system's one always-on motion gesture. Gates on prefers-reduced-motion.

rate-ticker-marquee.$description: RateTicker marquee — 40 second per loop, linear easing, infinite, pausable on hover. Used by Stat composites + lane code strips. Gates on prefers-reduced-motion.

aurora-fade.$description: Aurora ambient glow fade-in on expressive surfaces. 1.2s, decelerate. Gates on prefers-reduced-motion AND prefers-reduced-transparency (the aurora composes with backdrop-filter).
